programmes.d: After Mitch Baker’s father is killed by gun-runners, he follows them to Mexico for revenge. In the border town of Mission, Texas, Mitch faces off with gang leader Jim Simmons, determined to take justice into his own hands, despite warnings from the sheriff.
The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer.
Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.
A unique Euro-western with the hero as an astrologist who wears a leopard suit.
A Swedish arms dealer and a Mexican peon team up to rescue the intellectual leader of the Revolutionary cause, while taking part in numerous misadventures along the way.

Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.
A group of Mexican revolutionaries murders a town priest and a number of his christian followers. Ten years later, a widow arrives in town intent to take revenge from her husband's killers.

The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.
A man is falsely charged with bank robbery, prompting his brother to break him out of prison.

Ranch owner MacGregor has seven sons and oldest Gregor leads his brothers to Las Mesas, a small town where they want to sell horses. Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.
José Desman kills his employer, former judge Salazar, who had sentenced his father. This story explores revenge and personal justice as the son confronts the man responsible for his family’s tragedy.
